sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
In Escape from Tarkov, the handling of weapons can be trained through active use. In short, the more you use a certain weapon, the more skilled you become with it.

Depending on the weapon, reaching mastery level 2 or level 3 will provide a new reload animation. Level 3 grants the ability to reload while aiming down sights for all weapons in that mastery category.

Weapons that are based on the same platform share a mastery. 1 EXP is gained for every hit on entities in an online raid. For cartridges that fire multiple projectiles, each projectile hit gives EXP.
